notes: digestVectors: body is the lease body (v1, 9 keys). expected.ok = digest and the exact preimage bytes (UTF8 domain albera.wsl2-run-lease.v1, 0x00, enc(map)); otherwise code and field, the first failing field in the table order of validateWsl2RunLease.
The C# twin is Wsl2RunLease.cs. It reproduces every expected value here in the dotnet contract test.
verifyVectors: the public half of an EPHEMERAL ECDSA P-256 test key (publicKeySpki, base64 DER). The private key was discarded after signing; nothing secret is here.
A verifier is stateless: a reused lease and the call count are the bridge's to refuse, so no vector covers them.
Bindings are reported in the order baseOid, computerId, operationId, repositoryId.
The last two cases pin domain separation: a genuine network attestation is malformed here, and a signature made over an attestation does not verify for a lease.
